custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer's live transparency API names the suiUSDe backing custodians and wallets: Anchorage 2 and 3 (Sui USDC), Coinbase 1 (Coinbase Prime USDC), Coinbase 2 (Ethereum USDe and USDC), and a Sui mint/redeem wallet. At the 2026-07-20 capture the API reported $13,114,642.84 backing ($12,157,307.86 USDe and $957,334.98 USDC, a 100.14% ratio), but it does not publish legal segregation, insolvency treatment, rehypothecation terms, or target provider shares for this partner deployment.
